bugs.error_message: SSO first login for a brand new company threw NoSuchElementException from Optional.get()
bugs.root_cause: The company-creation path read the Administrator role from the freshly created company's roleList, which is always empty at that point. Roles are global defaults, not per-company.
bugs.fix: Resolve through roleService.findDefaultRoles() as UserService.signup() already does, and throw a typed CustomException instead of a bare NoSuchElementException if it is genuinely missing.

bugs.error_message: Any image built by the pipeline would serve a SPA hardcoded to http://localhost:8080
bugs.root_cause: Create React App compiles REACT_APP_API_URL into the JavaScript bundle at build time. api/pom.xml exposes it as the frontend.api.url property, but the Dockerfile ran `mvn package` with no way to receive it, so every image took the pom default.
bugs.fix: Added FRONTEND_API_URL / FRONTEND_ENABLE_SSO / FRONTEND_OAUTH2_PROVIDER build args passed through to -Dfrontend.* Maven properties. Defaults unchanged so a bare docker build behaves as before. Consequence documented: images are environment-specific and cannot be promoted.

bugs.error_message: REQUIREMENTS.md gave https://cmmsfiles.blob.core.windows.net as a MINIO_ENDPOINT value
bugs.root_cause: Wrote a plausible-looking Azure Blob URL without checking the SDK. STORAGE_TYPE=minio uses the MinIO Java SDK, which speaks the S3 API; Azure Blob Storage exposes no S3-compatible endpoint, so that value could never work regardless of network configuration.
bugs.fix: Corrected the documentation, then implemented a real Azure Blob backend (see bug-004 context). Rule: verify an SDK can actually talk to a service before putting it in a config example.

bugs.error_message: REQUIREMENTS.md described MINIO_ENDPOINT as 'the URL the server uses to reach the object store'
bugs.root_cause: Assumed the variable names described their roles. MinioService.init() actually builds the client on PUBLIC_MINIO_ENDPOINT for uploads, downloads and signing alike; MINIO_ENDPOINT is only an HTTP proxy target, and only when the public endpoint resolves to localhost.
bugs.fix: Rewrote the storage section from the init() method. In a real deployment MINIO_ENDPOINT should simply match PUBLIC_MINIO_ENDPOINT; it must still be non-empty or storage silently no-ops.

bugs.error_message: Error: Cycle: module.cmms.azurerm_role_assignment.blob_delegator, ...acr_pull, ...blob_contributor, module.cmms.azurerm_linux_web_app.cmms, ...kv_secrets
bugs.root_cause: Used a system-assigned managed identity. The role assignments reference azurerm_linux_web_app.identity[0].principal_id, so they can only be created after the web app, but the web app needs AcrPull to pull its first image and Key Vault access to resolve its first secret reference, so it depends_on them. Circular.
bugs.fix: Switched to a user-assigned identity (azurerm_user_assigned_identity.cmms). Role assignments hang off it, so every role lands before the web app exists and a cold apply produces a working app. Also required key_vault_reference_identity_id and container_registry_managed_identity_client_id, or the platform falls back to the absent system-assigned identity.

bugs.error_message: An input variable with the name "db_fqdn" has not been declared
bugs.root_cause: Renamed db_fqdn to db_host with a string replacement, but an earlier `tofu fmt -recursive` had realigned `DB_URL = ` to `DB_URL  = ` (two spaces), so the pattern no longer matched that one line and it kept the old variable reference.
bugs.fix: Grepped for the stale name and used a regex on var.db_fqdn rather than the whole line. Lesson: after tofu fmt, re-grep before relying on any literal string match, and always re-run tofu validate after a bulk edit.

bugs.error_message: git@ssh.dev.azure.com: Permission denied (password,publickey)
bugs.root_cause: The only local key is ~/.ssh/id_rsa (RSA, 2021) and it is not registered with the user's Azure DevOps account. Not the usual SHA-1 algorithm problem: retrying with PubkeyAcceptedAlgorithms=+ssh-rsa failed identically.
bugs.fix: Switched origin to HTTPS (https://EnerkemIT@dev.azure.com/...) and authenticated through Git Credential Manager with a PAT.

bugs.error_message: /usr/bin/bash: -c: line 162: unexpected EOF while looking for matching `''
bugs.root_cause: Tried to write a large YAML file through a bash heredoc. The embedded mixed quoting broke the shell and the file was never created, so the follow-up validation silently had nothing to check.
bugs.fix: Used the Write tool instead. Rule: heredocs are fine for short, simple content; anything large or quote-heavy goes through Write.

bugs.error_message: /usr/bin/bash: line 1: ./mvnw: No such file or directory
bugs.root_cause: Only mvnw.cmd is present in api/ — there is no POSIX mvnw wrapper in this repository.
bugs.fix: Run Maven through the PowerShell tool: $env:JAVA_HOME='C:\java\jdk-17'; cd C:\data\src\cmms\api; .\mvnw.cmd ...

bugs.error_message: The term 'tofu' is not recognized as a name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or executable program
bugs.root_cause: winget install OpenTofu.Tofu succeeded and modified PATH, but the already-running shell does not pick up the new PATH value.
bugs.fix: Invoke by full path: C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\OpenTofu.Tofu_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\tofu.exe

bugs.error_message: Planned database db-cancen-it-poet-test is unreachable from a canadaeast web app
bugs.root_cause: That server has publicNetworkAccess disabled and is VNet-injected into New-Implementations-vnet (canadacentral), whose only subnet is a /24 already delegated to Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers. No room for an App Service subnet, no private endpoint possible on a VNet-injected server, and regional VNet integration cannot cross regions.
bugs.fix: Use 10.225.1.107 instead — the private endpoint in VNET-CanEast-Tier1/Prod-Tier1-BackEnd that the budget app already uses. Same region as the web apps and as every existing App Service integration subnet.

bugs.error_message: Deploy-stage preflight compared the running image tag against $(targetEnv)/$(releaseVersion), which are empty outside the Build stage
bugs.root_cause: Azure DevOps task.setvariable is job-scoped. targetEnv and releaseVersion are set in the Build stage's job, so referencing them from the Test/Prod stages yields empty strings and the tag comparison would match nothing, failing every release.
bugs.fix: Re-derive the environment from the template's environmentName parameter and the version from $(Build.SourceBranch) (REF=${BUILD_SOURCEBRANCH#refs/tags/}; VERSION=${REF#*/}) inside the preflight step instead of reading cross-stage variables.

bugs.error_message: Both environments pointed at db_host 10.225.1.107, which is a test server, not the production database
bugs.root_cause: 10.225.1.107 is the private endpoint of db-caneast-django-pmo-test, a canadacentral TEST server. It was recorded as 'the shared server the budget app uses', but itbudget's DB_URL is 10.225.1.104 = db-caneast-pmdms. Production was aimed at a test database.
bugs.fix: infra/envs/prod/main.tf reads db_host from data.azurerm_private_endpoint_connection.prod_db (PMDMSPrivateEndpointPostgreSQL, RG-CanEast-PMDMS) and references the server via data.azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server. Both read-only, so tofu never manages them. Corrected the fact in cerebrum, REQUIREMENTS.md, infra/README.md and CLAUDE.md.

bugs.error_message: db-caneast-pmdms.postgres.database.azure.com resolves to 52.229.73.241 (public) from inside the VNet, so connecting by FQDN is refused
bugs.root_cause: The server has publicNetworkAccess disabled and is reachable only through a private endpoint, but no privatelink.postgres.database.azure.com private DNS zone is linked to VNET-CanEast-Tier1. The public FQDN CNAMEs to <server>.privatelink.postgres.database.azure.com, which without that zone resolves to the server's public address.
bugs.fix: Use the private endpoint IP (10.225.1.104) as db_host, read from the private endpoint data source rather than hardcoded. Documented the one-line switch to data.azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server.prod_db.fqdn for if a private DNS zone is ever linked. prod-pmdms and itbudget use the same literal IP.

bugs.error_message: Preflight read the running image from linuxFxVersion, which is the literal string 'sitecontainers' on the cmms web app
bugs.root_cause: cmms was created as a site containers (sidecar-model) app. Such apps report linuxFxVersion == 'sitecontainers' and keep the image on the main site container instead. Stripping the 'DOCKER|' prefix yields 'sitecontainers', matching no expected repository.
bugs.fix: Branch on linuxFxVersion: when it equals 'sitecontainers', read the image with `az webapp sitecontainers list --query "[?isMain].image | [0]"`; otherwise strip the DOCKER| prefix as before.

bugs.error_message: IllegalArgumentException: Illegal base64 character 2d at JwtTokenProvider.init - container exits during startup
bugs.root_cause: JwtTokenProvider.init() runs JWT_SECRET_KEY through Base64.getDecoder().decode() and then Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(), so the value must be strict base64 decoding to at least 32 bytes. The pipeline's smoke test hardcoded 'ci-only-secret-not-used-outside-this-job'; the hyphens (0x2d) are illegal base64, so the Spring context never started. The pipeline had never run, so this had never surfaced.
bugs.fix: The smoke test now generates the key with `openssl rand -base64 48`, with a comment explaining the constraint. Verified: the same image boots to /health-check in 7s with a generated key and fails identically with a hyphenated one.

bugs.error_message: dev.env was included in the AGPLv3 source bundle served publicly at GET /source-code/download
bugs.root_cause: The source zip is built from the Docker build context, so .dockerignore governs its contents. It excluded '.env' but not 'dev.env' or 'prod.env', both of which exist locally and are gitignored precisely because they carry DB passwords, LICENSE_KEY and the Entra client secret. Confirmed by unzipping the bundle from the running container: entry 'dev.env' was present.
bugs.fix: Added '*.env', '.env' and 'secrets-*.env' to .dockerignore, plus matching -x excludes on the zip in api/Dockerfile as defence in depth. Re-verified: the rebuilt bundle contains no .env entries. Any secrets already in dev.env should still be treated as exposed if an image built before this was ever published.

bugs.error_message: Source bundle 278 MB and jar 442 MB: three copies of a 251 MB OpenTofu provider binary shipped in every image
bugs.root_cause: infra/{bootstrap,envs/test,envs/prod}/.terraform each cache terraform-provider-azurerm.exe (251 MB). They are gitignored but not dockerignored, so they entered the build context and the AGPLv3 source zip embedded in the jar.
bugs.fix: Added '**/.terraform', tfstate and tfplan patterns to .dockerignore and matching zip excludes in api/Dockerfile. Bundle went 278 MB -> 93.2 MB; the three .terraform.lock.hcl files are deliberately kept, since they pin provider versions and are genuine source.

bugs.error_message: NOT-LISTENING reported for sshd on port 2222 inside the container
bugs.root_cause: False alarm from the check rather than a real fault: the verification used `ss`, which lives in iproute2 and is not installed (the Dockerfile installs net-tools, i.e. netstat, matching budget). A missing binary produced the same output as a dead service.
bugs.fix: Verified with `sshd -D -e` in the foreground ('Server listening on 0.0.0.0 port 2222'), `sshd -T` (port 2222, permitrootlogin yes, passwordauthentication yes), and finally `netstat -tlnp` in the real image showing 0.0.0.0:2222 alongside :::8080. Use netstat here, or confirm the tool exists before trusting a negative result.

bugs.error_message: REQUIREMENTS.md told the operator to run `az keyvault secret set --name smtp-password --value ''`, which Key Vault rejects
bugs.root_cause: The instruction assumed an unused secret could be stored as a blank placeholder, to avoid an unresolvable Key Vault reference stopping the container. Azure Key Vault does not accept an empty secret value, so the documented command cannot succeed and the documented setup could never be completed as written.
bugs.fix: Rewrote REQUIREMENTS.md section 2: only three secrets are required, and smtp-password is omitted entirely while mail is off - application.yml declares ${SMTP_PWD:} so the app defaults it to empty with no reference needed. Verified against application.yml which secrets have no default (DB_PWD, JWT_SECRET_KEY) and are therefore boot-critical.

bugs.error_message: setup-keyvault.ps1: Parameter cannot be processed because the parameter name 'o' is ambiguous. Possible matches include: -OutVariable -OutBuffer.
bugs.root_cause: The Invoke-Az/Test-Az helpers were advanced functions declaring `param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)][string[]] $Args)`. PowerShell binds leading-dash tokens as parameter names before ValueFromRemainingArguments applies, so `az ... -o json` tried to bind `-o` against the function's own common parameters and matched both -OutVariable and -OutBuffer. Naming the parameter $Args also shadows the automatic variable.
bugs.fix: Rewrote both helpers as SIMPLE functions with no param() block, reading the automatic $args and splatting it to az. Every token, dashes included, now reaches az untouched. Verified by running the script with -WhatIf against the live subscription.

bugs.error_message: Pipeline would have failed on both the ACR login and the deploy: service connection ids did not exist in the project
bugs.root_cause: Service connections in Azure DevOps are project-scoped. The two ids were copied from ../itsheets and ../budget, whose pipelines live in a different project, so neither resolved in 'New Services Implementations'. Nothing in the YAML or in a local check would reveal this - it only fails at run time.
bugs.fix: Listed the project's real endpoints with `az devops service-endpoint list` and used them: 784814e7-... ('DEVOPS - ACR', registry `enerkem`) and ca8fb3b0-... ('Enterprise'). Avoided b50e431e-... ('Docker Registy connector'), which points at sjusiccontainerregistry.

bugs.error_message: AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER was atlas-files; the real container is cmms
bugs.root_cause: The storage account has publicNetworkAccess Disabled and defaultAction Deny, so `az storage container list` failed from outside the network and the container name was guessed from the parked OpenTofu module's own naming (atlas-files) instead of being verified.
bugs.fix: The owner's repo-root prod.env showed the real name is `cmms`. Corrected in .azure/env/prod.env and the docs. Lesson: when a value cannot be verified, say so loudly rather than carrying a plausible guess into a config file.

bugs.error_message: Pushing tag release/1.6.0-enerkem.1 queued no pipeline run at all
bugs.root_cause: The trigger combined `branches: {exclude: ['*']}` with a separate `tags: {include: ['release/*']}` block. A branch filter that excludes every branch leaves the CI trigger with nothing to match, and the tags block does not compensate, so tag pushes fired nothing. The only run on the pipeline was a manual one against refs/heads/main, which the first step correctly rejected - masking the real problem behind an expected-looking failure.
bugs.fix: Express the tag filter as a refs/tags pattern inside branches.include: `branches: {include: ['refs/tags/release/*']}`. Ordinary branches still cannot match. Also split the tag-resolution error into three cases (branch/manual run, test tag, malformed version) so the message names the actual mistake. Requires deleting and re-pushing the tag, since the existing one points at a commit carrying the broken trigger.

bugs.error_message: JWT_SECRET_KEY was unexpected at this time - az webapp config appsettings set failed when passing Key Vault references
bugs.root_cause: On Windows `az` is az.cmd, so every argument PowerShell passes is re-parsed by cmd.exe. A Key Vault reference, @Microsoft.KeyVault(VaultName=v;SecretName=s), contains '(', ')' and ';'. cmd split on the ';' and reported the next token as unexpected. No PowerShell quoting fixes it, because PowerShell is not the layer doing the damage. Other az calls in the script worked only because their arguments happened to contain no cmd metacharacters.
bugs.fix: Added Set-AppSettingsFromFile, which writes the settings as a JSON array of {name,value,slotSetting} to a temp file and passes `--settings @file`, keeping the metacharacters off the command line. Payload shape verified against the output of `az webapp config appsettings list`. Temp file removed in a finally block; it holds no secrets, only vault and secret names.

bugs.error_message: A failure inside `az keyvault secret set` would have printed the full command line, including --value <the real secret>
bugs.root_cause: Invoke-Az threw a message built from `$azArgs -join ' '`, with no redaction. Any az failure while writing a secret would render that secret to the console and into any active PowerShell transcript. Found while reviewing the error output from the appsettings failure, which printed the whole command.
bugs.fix: Secret values are registered in a $script:Redact list as they are read from prod.env, and every error string passes through Hide-Secrets before display. Invoke-Az now reports the az exit code, the redacted command and az's own output separately.

bugs.error_message: atlas role had no CREATE privilege on schema public; Liquibase would have failed the first container start with 'permission denied for schema public'
bugs.root_cause: PostgreSQL 15+ no longer grants CREATE on the public schema to PUBLIC. The atlas database was correctly owned by atlas, but the public schema inside it was still owned by azure_pg_admin with ACL {azure_pg_admin=UC/azure_pg_admin,=U/azure_pg_admin} - so atlas inherited only USAGE. The app runs Liquibase on every boot and JPA with ddl-auto=validate, so it needs DDL rights.
bugs.fix: ALTER SCHEMA public OWNER TO atlas; GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO atlas; executed as enk_pg_admin, which is a member of both atlas and azure_pg_admin. The schema held 0 objects so no object ownership had to be migrated. Verified functionally with CREATE/INSERT/INDEX/ALTER/DROP under SET LOCAL ROLE atlas, not just by reading the ACL.

bugs.error_message: Failed to acquire a new access token ... Managed Identity authentication is not available; bean 'azureBlobService' init method failed, container stops
bugs.root_cause: The cmms web app has ONLY a user-assigned managed identity (ua-id-9ca4). DefaultAzureCredential's ManagedIdentityCredential cannot choose among user-assigned identities unless AZURE_CLIENT_ID names one, and AZURE_CLIENT_ID was never set. AzureBlobService.init() calls containerClient.exists(), so the auth failure killed the storageServiceFactory bean and the whole Spring context.
bugs.fix: Set AZURE_CLIENT_ID=dbb349c1-53e9-44b6-bac8-eb975ad1f92e on the app, and added it to .azure/env/prod.env and the pipeline's appSettings so it is reproducible. NOT the same as OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID: that is the Entra app registration for user sign-in and holds no Azure RBAC role - verified against the storage account's role assignments.

bugs.error_message: Diagnosed a stale crash loop as an unfixed bug: the pasted log predated the database grant fix
bugs.root_cause: App Service stops a site after repeated cold-start failures ('Site is blocked due to multiple, consecutive cold start failures' then 'Site: cmms stopped'). Nothing retried after the grant was applied, so the newest available log still showed the old error and looked current.
bugs.fix: Check the web app's state before concluding a fix failed. Here: the grant was verified still in place, the exact Liquibase DDL was replayed successfully as role atlas, then starting the site proved it - 802 changesets applied in ~23s.

bugs.error_message: Every container failure reports 'Container exited with exit code 0 during startup', masking real crashes
bugs.root_cause: The script ends with `java ... 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"`. A shell pipeline returns the exit status of its LAST command, so the script exits 0 regardless of how java terminated. App Service then reports a clean exit for what was actually a fatal Spring failure.
bugs.fix: NOT YET FIXED. Needs ${PIPESTATUS[0]} under bash (the entrypoint is `sh`, and dash has no pipefail), plus a rebuild to take effect. Recorded so the misleading exit code does not derail the next diagnosis.

bugs.error_message: Could not resolve placeholder 'MAIL_RECIPIENTS' in value "${MAIL_RECIPIENTS}" (emailService2) when running app.jar from a shell with dev.env
bugs.root_cause: mail.recipients has no default in application.yml and dev.env does not define MAIL_RECIPIENTS; the IntelliJ run config supplies it.
bugs.fix: Pass MAIL_RECIPIENTS=<addr> (and ENABLE_EMAIL_NOTIFICATIONS=false) when launching outside IntelliJ; run-local.sh takes KEY=VAL overrides.

bugs.error_message: Error configuring MinIO: Failed to connect to /127.0.0.1:9000 (minioService init) on local start
bugs.root_cause: dev.env uses STORAGE_TYPE=minio; no MinIO was running. There is no local-filesystem StorageType (only GCP/MINIO/AZURE).
bugs.fix: docker run -d --name cmms-minio -p 9000:9000 -p 9001:9001 -e MINIO_ROOT_USER=$MINIO_ACCESS_KEY -e MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=$MINIO_SECRET_KEY quay.io/minio/minio server /data --console-address :9001. Do not pipe docker run into head (SIGPIPE killed the pull).

bugs.error_message: v1.8.0 Liquibase changeset 2026_07_16_00000000001_create_unaccent would fail on Azure Flexible Server: extension not allow-listed
bugs.root_cause: azure.extensions on db-caneast-pmdms was PG_TRGM,PG_STAT_STATEMENTS; CREATE EXTENSION unaccent is refused unless allow-listed.
bugs.fix: Owner added UNACCENT to azure.extensions (verified PG_STAT_STATEMENTS,PG_TRGM,UNACCENT). Prerequisite recorded in REQUIREMENTS.md.

bugs.error_message: Browser SPA called http://localhost:8080/license/state although the jar was built with frontend.api.url=localhost:8085 (CORS error). Served bundle main.e007f40e.js != frontend/build main.34e707df.js
bugs.root_cause: A stale gitignored SPA copy (2026-06-18) in api/src/main/resources/static was copied by maven-resources into the jar; -DskipFrontend=true also skips the prepare-package copy of frontend/build that would overwrite it.
bugs.fix: Deleted the ignored files (kept source/), staged frontend/build into target/classes/static and repackaged; .dockerignore now excludes those paths. Verify the main.<hash>.js in the served index.html.

bugs.error_message: JSON parse error: Invalid UTF-8 middle byte 0x74 on POST /locations with accented names from a bash curl -d '...'
bugs.root_cause: Git Bash passes UTF-8 command-line arguments to native curl.exe through the Windows ANSI codepage, so multi-byte characters arrive as single cp1252 bytes.
bugs.fix: Write payloads to files with printf \xNN escapes and send them with --data-binary @file (api-smoke2.sh).

bugs.error_message: GET /source-code/download with a Range header -> 500 java.util.zip.ZipException: ZipFile closed (ResourceRegionHttpMessageConverter); GET /runtime-env.js -> 500 NoResourceFoundException
bugs.root_cause: Range requests on a nested-jar ClassPathResource fail in Spring Boot 3.2's region converter; runtime-env.js is generated only by `npm start` and upstream's exception handler maps missing static resources to 500.
bugs.fix: NOT FIXED (pre-existing, documented in DEVELOPMENT-STATUS 12.18). Options: StreamingResponseBody for the bundle; commit a static runtime-env.js or serve it from a controller.
